patch.value: SDK commit fence delays dead-owner crash recovery beyond the default lock wait

SDK 2026.10.23 introduces a commit fence whose orphaned cleanup gate prevents automatic dead-owner lock takeover within the default three-second wait. The full deterministic minimal reproduction and CI evidence are recorded on pm-rlm-tc1023. Preserve the package crash-safety assertions and require an upstream SDK fix rather than package retries.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Contract check: upstream issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1549 separates mutation-lease fencing from already-completed dead-owner recovery. The published SDK source returns from cleanup-gate recovery while the gate age is at most 10000 ms, before inspecting its recorded owner. Thus a provably killed fence owner still blocks the default 3000 ms acquisition, as the minimal reproduction shows. This supports treating the recovery delay as an SDK regression rather than adding a package retry layer. The original issue concerns preventing stale overwrite; this follow-up concerns crash recovery after that fix.

value.author: glm-agent
value.text: Decision update (owner-directed): instead of waiting for the upstream fix to unbraind/pm-cli#1609, this branch ships a package-side bounded retry for dead-owner lock conflicts. Acceptance: (1) every ledger SDK mutation treats lock_conflict with reason lock_owner_dead as retryable with bounded backoff and jitter, total budget 15s configurable through ledger options; live-owner lock_conflict still fails fast with the typed error. (2) The SIGKILL root-write test stays strict (previous budget/transcript intact AND next writer succeeds); add a live-owner fails-fast test and a bounded-budget test (permanently dead owner fails with the typed error after the budget, never hangs). (3) README storage/recovery note citing pm-cli#1609, removable once upstream ships. (4) Changelog regenerated the repo's way. Prefer the SDK lock-wait option over a hand-rolled loop if the pinned SDK exposes one.

value.author: glm-agent
value.text: Revert proof (behavioural): with only the retry wrapper reverted (RlmLedger.mutate made a passthrough, no other change), the new bounded-budget regression test fails with 'The retry budget must be spent before failing' because the permanently fenced dead-owner lock surfaces the SDK lock_conflict immediately. The pre-fix SIGKILL root-write failure is the red main run (lock_conflict lock_owner_dead after waiting 3002ms from RlmLedger.complete). Timing note: locally the SIGKILL root test can pass even without the retry because the post-kill checkpoint read is slow enough under host load that the commit-fence gate is already within its ten-second expiry window when resume starts, so the SDK's internal three-second wait reaches the takeover; CI's faster gap is what failed. The new tests pin the semantics deterministically regardless of that gap.

value.author: glm-agent
value.text: Design notes: (1) Every RlmLedger SDK mutation now runs through a bounded dead-owner retry: schema field registration, checkpoint save (commitItemMutations), call materialize (create + claim), complete (comments, usage transaction, close, release) and both run-lease acquireLock calls; the SDK's own lock-wait option cannot be used because the item-lock wait comes from workspace settings (locks.wait_ms) while the only per-call lockWaitMs options apply to workspace transaction locks, and raising the process-global PM_LOCK_WAIT_MS would also slow live-owner refusals, violating fails-fast. (2) The retry matches only lock_conflict with reason lock_owner_dead; live-owner and owner-unknown conflicts plus every other error rethrow immediately. (3) The deterministic evaluation item (rlm-eval-<id>, resumable across crashes) also retries its create and description CAS through the same helper. Orchestration parents in adaptive/reconcile/engine are excluded: they are freshly generated ids created in the same live process, so no dead-owner takeover is needed there. (4) Budget default 15s, configurable as RlmLedgerOptions.deadOwnerRetryMs; backoff follows the SDK's published retry_after_ms hint doubled per attempt, capped at 2s, with 50-150% jitter.

patch.value: Work around pinned SDK commit-fence dead-owner recovery regression (unbraind/pm-cli#1609) in every crash-sensitive ledger and resumable evaluation mutation. Enforce a monotonic deadline before every mutation retry and cap sleep by retry hint, bounded jittered backoff and remaining budget. Share the deadline guard with storage busy retries. Preserve typed live-owner refusals, strict SIGKILL crash-safety assertions, non-git operation, public SDK and CLI outputs, and packed npm/native Bun consumers. Default budget 15 seconds; zero starts no mutation. Remove this workaround after the upstream fix ships and the dependency pin advances.
